programs.title: LEGO DreamZzz
programs.desc: Despite Grand Inspector Royce's orders, the dream chasers go after their missing memories. They try to track one of the Never Witch's ravens back to her hide-out while Phil covers for them at Castle Nocturnia, releasing a swarm of bed bugs to keep Royce distracted.
